fields.FIR_Description: During the afternoon of 2025-08-30, around 14:00, a person claiming to be a recruitment agent took Rs. 4,00,000 from the complainant for a job offer that did not materialise, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-09-01. Contact details given by the complainant, Kishore Velan, include the number 9000000140. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. The complainant alleged that Eswari Raj may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000433. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00055, as the mobile number 9000000433 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Agent reportedly issued a forged offer letter and became unreachable.
fields.Keywords: job fraud, cheating, afternoon, suspect, call detail, digital document, mobile number, residential colony
